messages:
lucy-ux: Heads-up: I'm reworking the left navigation IA. Proposal is to shift from a hierarchical "org first" list to a task-focused grouping: Deployments, Models, Billing, Config. Need sign-off on routing and a11y implications before I update mocks.
ben-fe: Task-first grouping makes sense. Two engineering rules: (1) collapsing/compact toggles must be DOM/CSS-only (no history mutation), (2) panels should be reflected by query params (panel=overview|metrics|logs) rather than path-only changes.
harper-a11y: From an accessibility POV: when a deep link opens a panel, programmatically move keyboard focus to the panel heading and use an aria-live region to announce e.g. "Panel: Metrics opened". If the URL includes an anchor (line/row), scroll to it first, then set focus and announce. Skip link ordering should be: Skip to main content, Skip to Projects, Skip to search.
jorge-prod: Product asks: old public links must still work. We can keep a small redirect table on the server to map /workspace/:id/... to /app/:org/projects/:id?panel=... Also copy: nav label should be "Projects" and copy-to-clipboard toast should say something like "Link copied — opens Logs at line 128".
lucy-ux: Breadcrumb guidance: use chevrons (>) and remove trailing slashes. Breadcrumbs should reflect task path (Projects > MyApp > Logs). When the nav is compact the breadcrumb remains visible and should still show the active panel.
ben-fe: Quick router sketch to align engineers:
```
// canonical deep link
/app/:org/projects/:projectId?panel=logs&anchor=line-128
// UX rules
- on route changes: history.pushState
- on visual-only toggles (collapse): do not touch history
- on arrival with anchor: wait for element visible -> focus -> announce
```
This avoids back-button regressions we've seen when replaceState was used for UI flags.
harper-a11y: Also ensure any auto-opening tooltips or tips are suppressed on initial navigation if the incoming URL contains panel/anchor. Those widgets steal focus and confuse screen reader users. Defer them 250-300ms or skip on deep-link.
jorge-prod: For link compatibility, we'll maintain a tiny map for legacy paths and add test coverage for redirection. Also product wants a one-liner tooltip for Projects: "Projects — your team workspaces and deployments."
lucy-ux: Minor copy tweak: prefer "Projects" (plural) on the nav label and singular project names in the breadcrumb.
ben-fe: I'll remove any analytics calls that used history.replaceState and switch analytics to postMessage to a non-history endpoint to avoid history side-effects. I'll open a PR with tests that assert: legacy redirect -> panel+anchor loads -> fragment scrolls -> focus set -> aria-live contains panel name.
build-bot: ci: nav-ia-refactor build #5532 succeeded :white_check_mark:
lucy-ux: Great. If no further concerns we'll lock on task-focused clusters + panel query param routing + fragment-first focus/announce behavior. I'll update the figma and post a short keyboard nav prototype. Thanks everyone.
